title: 僵尸与外星人凌晨抢甜甜圈
author: @bmx_ai13
summary: 凌晨 2 点甜甜圈店只剩最后一个，时间定格后僵尸和外星人大打出手、握手又反悔，最后抢同一个甜甜圈；带英文台词、角色锁定和音效细则。
prompt:
A zombie and an alien walk into a donut shop at 2am only one donut left

Seedance 2.5 Prompt ⤵️

FORMAT: 30 seconds | 24fps cinematic | ultra photorealistic live action | studio comedy action | practical prosthetic creature makeup | VFX time freeze | 2am fluorescent night interior. Real-time, no random slow motion.

NO ON-SCREEN TEXT - CRITICAL: no captions, subtitles, titles, logos, watermarks, timecode or UI at any point. Menu board and case labels are blank coloured panels, never legible.

IDENTITY LOCK: the same two leads in every shot, never changing face, skin, height, wardrobe or props. No morphing, no extra fighters. The cashier and four customers become frozen statues after 0:03 and never move, blink or react until 0:27.

CHARACTERS
THE ZOMBIE: 6 foot 2, gaunt, grey-green mottled skin with dry cracked patches, cloudy pale eyes, sunken sockets, lank dark hair, no wounds, no blood. Torn navy night-shift security uniform, crooked clip-on tie, one shoe untied. Moves stiff and heavy, then surprisingly quick. Voice: deep gravelly rasp, slow, every word an effort.
THE ALIEN: 4 foot 10, slender, smooth pale lilac skin, large glossy black almond eyes, small nostril slits, narrow bald cranium, long four-fingered hands. Oversized yellow tourist rain poncho, small cross-body camera. Voice: light, clipped, overly correct English with a faint electronic flutter.

ENVIRONMENT: a narrow 24-hour donut shop at 2am. Cream tile floor, chrome stools, a lit glass display case along the right wall, all trays empty except exactly ONE glazed donut on a paper doily, glowing under the case light. Rain streaking the front window, a red traffic light outside.

0:00-0:03 THE FREEZE
Handheld medium down the counter. A customer drops a coffee cup, coffee arcing. The zombie and the alien lunge at the case from opposite ends. Sound drops out. Everything stops: coffee hangs as a glossy brown ribbon, raindrops pinned on the glass, the cashier's yawn locked open. Only the two leads keep moving.

0:03-0:08 REALIZATION
Both straighten, look at the hanging coffee, then each other. Slow 30 degree orbit.
ALIEN: "I have crossed four galaxies for this donut."
ZOMBIE: "I... died... for this donut."
ALIEN: "That is not the same thing."

0:08-0:13 FIRST EXCHANGE
The zombie swings a long stiff arm, the alien ducks, slides on wet tile and kicks a stool into his shins. He topples, catches the counter, groans. Whip pan as she vaults onto the counter.

0:13-0:18 THE FLASH
She snaps her camera in his face, a hard white flash. He staggers, then pulls a folded umbrella from a frozen customer with real effort, the customer staying rigid.
ZOMBIE: "Rude."

0:18-0:23 COUNTER FIGHT
Fast tracking shot. She leaps stool to stool over frozen shoulders, he swings the umbrella, she parries with a frozen customer's rolled newspaper. Three crisp readable exchanges. His clip-on tie pops off. Her hood flops over her eyes.

0:23-0:27 TRUCE
Both stop, breathing hard, hands on knees, coffee ribbon between them.
ALIEN: "Share?"
ZOMBIE: "Share."
They shake hands, four lilac fingers in a grey palm. Micro pause. Both eyes flick to the donut.

0:27-0:30 TIME RESUMES
Both dive at the case. The world unfreezes: coffee splashes down, the cashier finishes the yawn, customers jolt, rain runs, fridge hum slams back.

LAST FRAME: locked medium wide down the counter. The zombie and the alien pressed cheek to cheek at the open case, both gripping the one donut, glaze stretching between their hands, both grinning, coffee spraying through the light. Cashier and customers turn to stare. No text, captions, subtitles, signage lettering, logos or watermarks anywhere in frame.

CAMERA: controlled handheld in exchanges, smooth dolly and orbit on freeze reveals, low angle for the zombie, eye level for the alien, fast whip pans. Shallow depth on dialogue, consistent screen direction.

LIGHT AND COLOUR: cold overhead fluorescent key, warm amber case glow on faces and the donut, red street light through the rainy window. 70% cool tile and skin, 20% case amber, 10% red.

VFX AND PHYSICS: frozen liquid holds surface tension and highlights. The resume restores gravity in one continuous frame, no morphing, no dissolve. Stools scrape and tip, his heavy fall shakes the counter, she lands light, poncho crackling and lagging, true contact shadows. Nothing floats except the deliberately frozen.

ACTING: natural blinking, active brows on the zombie, the alien's eyes narrowing and widening, dry deadpan timing. Only the speaker's mouth forms words.

AUDIO, DIEGETIC ONLY: fridge hum and rain before the freeze. During it near-silence: breathing, a dry groan, sneaker squeak on wet tile, poncho crackle, stool scrape, umbrella whoosh, shutter clack. At resume: splash, gasps, rain and hum return. These are the only words spoken. No music, no score, no humming, no swell, no drone.

LOCKS: No blood, no gore, no wounds. No duplicated people, no extra limbs, the alien always has four fingers. No wardrobe or face changes, no cartoon physics, no excessive shake. Dry comedy, readable fight, coherent physics.

PROTAGONIST: @image 1 (facial identity, hair, rose-pink streaks, long side braid, plum shirt and cream cargo trousers locked to the reference throughout). Her movement is sharp, decisive and fluid. She dominates the entire fight and takes down ten masked attackers in a rapid chain.

OPPONENTS: Ten masked "Ashen Guard" fighters in charcoal hooded rain coats and slate face wraps, armed with bamboo staffs and short batons. They close in from above, from the sides and from behind. Mossy stone terrace walls, narrow wet stone staircases, a shallow water-filled irrigation channel running down the slope, a collapsed wooden footbridge with a gap, rusted tea-drying racks, leaning bamboo scaffolding and a thin waterfall at the cliff edge. Low golden sun cuts in from the side through light haze. Palette: moss green, wet slate grey, warm amber, deep plum. Kicked-up water spray, mud flecks, torn tea leaves and mist react to every impact. She lands and slides sideways under attacker 2's staff swing, then snaps a rising elbow to his chin; he drops flat into the wet tea bushes.

SHOT 2 (2.5-5s) Tracking from the side, FOV 40 degrees. She plants her foot on the mossy terrace wall, runs three steps up it and delivers a diagonal kick to attacker 3, who loses balance and tumbles down the staircase. Without pause she uses a leaning bamboo pole to spring into the air and drives a knee into attacker 4, who collapses onto the stones.

SHOT 3 (5-7.5s) Camera glides close to the ground and sweeps upward, FOV 30 degrees. She sprints downhill in a low crouch under hanging bamboo and ropes, spins into a sweeping kick that sends attacker 5 crashing into a rusted tea rack. Hand-plant roll, then a flying kick into attacker 6, who skids backward into the edge of the terrace wall.

SHOT 4 (7.5-10s) Camera orbits her, FOV 32 degrees. She slides on her knees through the shallow irrigation channel, throwing up a wide sheet of water, and pops up at the collapsed footbridge. She vaults the gap and twists mid-air to ram her shoulder into attacker 7, sending him to the terrace below. She lands, catches a bamboo pole thrown by attacker 8, plants it and pole-vaults, driving both feet into attackers 8 and 9, who fly in opposite directions.

SHOT 5 (10-12.5s) Camera pushes forward as if chasing, then pulls back fast, FOV 38 degrees. She runs along the leaning bamboo scaffolding, then back-flips over attacker 10's sneak attack from behind. Mid-air she twists and lands a back kick between his shoulder blades, sending him rolling forward down the slope.

SHOT 6 (12.5-15s) Camera drops to a low wide angle, FOV 30 degrees, then locks front-on at eye level. She lands and slides through a puddle in a low crouch, water spraying around her, then rises into a sharp ready stance. Her braid and the hem of her shirt are still swinging from the speed. The sequence ends sharply on this strong, still pose, final frame in crisp focus.

CAMERA: Momentum-driven tracking that follows her center of gravity (jumps, wall-runs, pole vault, kicks) rather than sitting static. Reactive impact cinematography: a sharp small shake on every hit, the camera briefly following a thrown opponent, then snapping back to her. Natural motion blur on fast moves.

PACING: Speed builds through the explosive moments. Her actions are clear and decisive; enemy reactions are fast and heavy. No slow motion, no pauses, no posed moments, no wasted movement.

VISUAL QUALITY: Ultra-high definition, cinema grade, realistic skin, fabric and water physics, live-action photographic look.

POSITIVE LOCKS: Pink streaks stay a soft rose tone, braid stays on her right shoulder, plum shirt and cream cargo trousers unchanged, boots and gloves unchanged, exactly ten attackers in charcoal coats and slate face wraps.

CONSTRAINTS: At least ten enemies, all hit. No empty kicks; every strike connects. No repeated moves. No fantasy light effects, no neon colors, no neon glow, no cartoon or CGI-style look, no distorted limbs, no clipping or objects passing through each other, no stuttering motion, no extra people, no text or watermarks.

title: 车内哭笑口播：第一次去男友家
author: @john87445528
summary: 24 秒竖屏两段口播：女主趴方向盘哭笑讲述第一次见男友爸，被叫「亲家」。
prompt:
【成片设定】
24秒，分两段各12秒，9:16竖屏，每段一镜到底。
真实手机前置自拍。女主角趴在停稳汽车的方向盘上，哭笑混杂地讲述第一次去男友家的经历。

【参考分工】
人物参考图锁定同一成年女性面孔、五官比例与黑色长发。
《相亲表情参考》锁定故事与台词。
《气得肚子疼》锁定夸张挤眼、皱鼻、咧嘴露齿、哭笑破音、偏头和肩膀颤动。
最新服装参考图锁定服装，不继承参考人物的面孔和背景。

【服装】
米白色微光泽修身细肩带短款上衣，主体不透明，领口露出黑色蕾丝内搭边缘；同色宽颈带及细带连接结构。
黑色牛仔短裤、黑色腰带与银色方扣，其他下装细节按服装参考图保持一致。

【场景与构图】
汽车停稳，窗外景物静止。
她坐在驾驶座，身体前倾，右前臂搭在方向盘上沿，侧脸间歇靠在前臂上，不压方向盘中央。
左手持短自拍杆，手机前置广角镜头距离约80—100厘米，稍向下拍。
始终完整拍到头顶、双肩、双臂、胸腹至腰部。方向盘位于画面下方，不遮脸。
车窗自然光、真实皮肤纹理、普通手机压缩质感。
镜头随持机手和肩膀颤动轻晃，不切镜、不推成脸部特写。

【表情要求】
采用《气得肚子疼》的夸张幅度：
眉心紧紧拧住，双眼用力挤闭，鼻梁皱起，脸颊被挤高；
嘴角横向拉开、张嘴露齿，随后突然下撇，下巴轻颤；
肩膀和胸腹随破碎笑声、急促吸气明显起伏。
她觉得委屈、尴尬，又荒唐得忍不住笑，不是开心大笑。
讲台词时努力收住，句间再次破功；关键台词必须听清。

第一段｜第一次去他家｜12秒
0—1.2秒：
她侧脸靠在方向盘上沿的右前臂上，双眼挤闭，眉心紧皱，咧嘴露齿，漏出两声短促苦笑：
“哈……啊……”
肩膀颤动，随后吸气抬脸。

1.2—4.5秒：
她勉强睁眼看屏幕，嘴角下撇，努力说清：
“处了个对象，比我小一轮。”
说到“一轮”时瞪大眼睛，随后闭眼皱鼻，像自己也觉得离谱。

4.5—7.5秒：
她偏头，又转回镜头，带着委屈说：
“第一次上他家。”
说完紧抿嘴唇，鼻翼牵动，压住一声快漏出来的笑。

7.5—11秒：
她接着说：
“去了之后，他爸给我又倒水又端茶。”
“他爸”两个字清楚强调，不能说成男友本人。
右前臂仍搭在方向盘上，头随叙述轻点，最后嘴角开始抽动。

11—12秒：
她双眼挤闭，咧嘴露齿，发出一声带哭腔的短笑。
头偏靠右前臂，肩膀继续轻颤，停在想讲下去却忍不住的状态。

第二段｜被男友爸爸叫“亲家”｜12秒
【续写起点】
从第一段最后一帧继续，同一机位、人物、服装与光线。
她侧脸靠右前臂，身体前倾，肩膀还有余颤。

0—3秒：
她吸气抬脸，眉头紧皱，勉强睁眼看手机，说：
“给我讲话老客气了。”
说“老客气了”时认真点一下头，嘴角下撇，像在强调对方确实特别客气。

3—4.5秒：
她眼睛睁大，嘴巴半张，接着说：
“他跟我讲……”
停顿一下，努力抿住嘴角。
这里的“他”始终指男友爸爸。

4.5—7.5秒：
她暂时收住哭笑，用郑重、客气的语气复述男友爸爸的话：
“亲家，你路上辛苦了。”
“亲家”清晰、完整，不被笑声盖住。
保持自然女性声线，只模仿客气语气，不突然变成男性声音。

7.5—9秒：
她瞪着屏幕僵住半秒，眉毛抬高、嘴唇紧闭。
随后眉心猛地挤紧，双眼用力闭上，嘴角横向拉开，露出上下牙，突然破功。

9—12秒：
爆出断续、带哭腔的苦笑：
“哈哈哈……啊……哈哈！”
下巴颤动，鼻子皱起，嘴角在咧开与下撇之间变化。
右手移到腹部按住，身体向前轻蜷，随后右前臂回到方向盘上沿，脸朝镜头侧靠上去。
肩膀继续颤动，以哭笑混杂和一口长呼气结束。
不再增加解释或收尾台词，让“亲家”本身完成笑点。
【音频与连续性】
自然成年女性口语，台词、口型、笑声、呼吸与肩膀起伏同步。
保留衣料摩擦、前臂接触方向盘的轻响和车内底噪，无音乐、无旁白。
全程保持同一张脸、同一服装和完整上半身构图。
不生成男友、男友爸爸或回忆画面。
不把“小一轮”改成“小一岁”，不把“上他家”改成“上我家”，不把端茶倒水的人改成男友。
不换脸、不穿模、不增加手臂或异常手指，不切镜、不慢动作。
无字幕、贴纸、水印或平台界面。

She wakes up in her modest Seoul apartment as soft morning sunlight streams through the curtains. She squints at the brightness, buries her face in her pillow, and lazily pulls the blanket over her head. Her friend filming laughs and calls her name. She finally sits up, rubs her eyes, stretches with a huge yawn, and checks the old bedside clock. Suddenly realizing how late she is, she looks directly at the camera and says, “Wait… it's already morning?!”

She jumps out of bed, ties her messy hair, slips on her sneakers, grabs her small shopping bag, and rushes out of the apartment. The camera follows shakily down the stairs into a quiet Seoul neighborhood filled with parked bicycles, overhead wires, small shops opening for the day, and warm morning sunlight.

She walks to a small neighborhood park, where she stops at an outdoor water tap. Water drips down her fingers, and she laughs when a few drops land on her pastel-blue top.

She sits on a low concrete wall beneath the trees, eats her breakfast, watches people walking to work, and offers a chip toward the camera as if sharing it with her friend.

Finally, she walks back along the sunny residential street, looking much more awake. At the apartment entrance, she turns toward the camera, smiles, and says, “Okay, now I'm officially awake!” Her friend laughs, the camera shakes wildly, and the footage ends abruptly.

CAMERA & FOOTAGE: Authentic 4 :3 early-2000s MiniDV footage, handheld shake, imperfect framing, accidental zooms, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild compression noise, and natural motion blur. No polished cinematography or smooth tracking shots.

SETTING: A modest Seoul apartment and an older Korean residential neighborhood circa 2003, small convenience stores, narrow streets, bicycles, overhead wires, leafy parks, and warm morning sunlight.

AUDIO: Birds chirping, distant scooters, alarm clock ringing, footsteps, shop door chime, snack packaging, running water, casual conversation, yawning, and spontaneous laughter. Natural English dialogue, no background music or narration.

REALISM & CONTINUITY: Believable sleepy behavior, realistic movements, natural sunlight, consistent clothing and accessories, and one continuous character identity. The entire video should feel like a forgotten personal recording from 2003, not a staged production.

title: 第九次告白：时间暂停的雨棚恋曲

prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5 /《第九次告白》双人奇幻爱情短片导演提示词

Duration：30秒
Aspect ratio：9:16竖屏

SUBJECT / Reference / 角色绑定：
@图片1 命名为【时言】，成年男主，面容、发型、眼镜、体型与全套穿着严格依据角色卡。
@图片2 命名为【知夏】，成年女主，面容、发型、体型与全套穿着严格依据角色卡。
以下正文一律使用中文名字指代。
参考图是同一人物的造型展示，不是多人合照。每张图只生成一个完整人物，不复制三视图、不继承拼图分栏或灰色摄影棚背景。

ENVIRONMENT / GLOBAL CONTINUITY：
Setting：雨天街角的小咖啡店门廊。两人站在宽雨棚下面，衣服与头发基本干燥；雨棚外是距离两人约两米的雨幕，后方为深灰色街道。画右背景有一盏店内暖黄吊灯，门窗没有可读文字。
Main subject：只有时言与知夏两人。时言画左，知夏画右，面对面相距约八十厘米。两人之间没有桌子或障碍物。
Lighting：阴天天光从门廊外侧照入，店内吊灯给发丝和肩膀一层很淡的暖边。摄影机位于脸部阴影侧，眼睛与嘴唇保持可读。
Color：灰蓝雨幕、黑色衣料、自然肤色与少量暖黄灯光。

奇幻规则：
时言用左手打响指，能够暂停环境时间；再次打响指，环境恢复。
暂停时，雨滴停在原来的空间位置，不继续下落、不变成冰、不发光。摄影机移动时，前后雨滴产生真实视差。
这项能力始终对知夏无效。她过去一直配合他假装被暂停，等他真正向自己告白。
本片只展示第九次，不插八段回忆。
0.4—18.4秒环境暂停；18.4秒以后环境恢复，并持续到结尾。
两人始终可以正常呼吸、说话和移动。知夏只在前五秒主动维持假装暂停的姿势。

CAMERA CONTINUITY：
全片六个镜头，在5.0、9.0、12.0、17.0、24.0秒硬切（Hard cut）。
始终保持时言在左、知夏在右的对话轴线，不越轴。
镜头从交代奇幻现象的双人中景，进入眼神与嘴角的近景，最后回到可看见牵手和亲吻的双人构图。
不插无人物空镜，不环绕炫技，不用数字变焦。

PERFORMANCE ENGINE：
时言想告白，却害怕听见答案，所以一直躲进暂停的时间里练习。
表演顺序：确认她“停住”→小声说出真心→被拆穿后短暂僵住→发现她在等待→主动恢复时间→再次告白。
紧张表现为左手指尖摩擦、吞咽、视线躲开半拍；最后一次告白时，手安静下来，眼睛不再躲。

知夏早就知道他的秘密，也喜欢他。
前五秒忍住笑；拆穿时只有眼睛和单侧嘴角先动，不演成嘲笑。
说“一直都能”时笑意收轻，让他看见认真；主动递出手，却把最后靠近的选择留给他。
全片情绪高点只落在结尾的相互靠近，没有哭喊或夸张惊讶。

AUDIO / 声音与台词：
普通话对白，声音自然，逐字口型同步（Lip-sync）；只有当前说话者做对应说话口型。

0.0—0.4秒：清楚的落雨声。
0.4秒：一次干脆的响指，落雨声骤然截断，只保留两人的呼吸与衣料声。

24.6—26.2秒：知夏回答：“这遍，算数。”

SHOT 1（0.0—5.0秒）｜他把世界按了暂停

Subject：时言、知夏。

Action：
第一帧两人已经站在雨棚下，知夏正用左手把耳边一缕头发拨到耳后。

0.8—2.0秒，时言先看一眼悬停的雨，再看她的眼睛，悄悄吐出一口气。

两人身后保留大片清楚可辨的静止雨滴；近处两三颗较大的檐口水滴帮助观众立即看懂时间被停止。

35mm双人腰部以上中景（Medium two-shot），从第一帧开始轻缓向前推进（Slow push-in），结束在两人胸部以上。响指、双方表情与背景雨滴都能看见。

奇幻发生得干净、安静；响指后没有光圈或能量波。

时言说“喜欢”时目光短暂抬回她脸上，说“你”时声音放轻。

必须在同一镜头里看见雨从下落到悬停。

Subject：知夏，时言肩膀位于画左前景。

5.0秒承接上一镜，知夏左手仍在耳侧。
5.2秒，她先把视线转向时言，然后把左手自然放下，头跟着转回来。

“一直”说得平稳，“能”落得很轻。
伸手后下唇轻轻抿住，眼睛始终看着他；她也在等一个可能让自己紧张的答案。

Constraints：
伸手只做一次，不抓住或拖拽时言。
不提前亲吻，不露出已经得到答案的灿烂笑容。

────────────────────

SHOT 5（17.0—24.0秒）｜他终于不躲了

Subject：时言、知夏。

Action：
承接知夏伸出的左手。
17.0—18.0秒，时言低头看她掌心，轻轻吸气，随后重新看她。
18.4秒，他用左手打响指。
雨滴立即沿原方向继续落下，雨声同时回归。
19.0—20.0秒，他用右手接住知夏的左手，掌心贴合，手指自然合拢。
20.0—20.8秒，他朝她迈近半步，两人距离缩短到约四十厘米。
21.0—22.6秒，他直视她，重新说：“我喜欢你。”
这次说完不躲、不低头，握着她的手等回答。
知夏先轻吸一口气，随后眼睛慢慢弯起来。

Environment：
恢复运动的雨幕与两人处于同一画面；观众清楚看见他主动让世界恢复。

Camera：
40mm双人中景（Medium two-shot），腰部以上入画，双手与脸同时可见。
18.4秒恢复时间时保持机位稳定，不切走遮掩变化；随后极缓推进（Slow push-in）。

Style：
雨声回归带来真实生活的重量，钢琴仍低于人声。

Performance：
第二次“我喜欢你”比第一次更稳，音量只略大，不喊。
知夏听完先松开肩膀，再露出笑意，不抢在台词结束前反应。

Constraints：
响指使用左手；牵手使用时言右手与知夏左手，跨镜头不得换手。
雨滴必须继续向下落，不能倒放、爆散或化成粒子。

────────────────────

SHOT 6（24.0—30.0秒）｜这一次算数

Subject：时言、知夏。

Action：
两人承接上一镜的位置和牵手状态。
24.6—26.2秒，知夏仰脸看着他说：“这遍，算数。”
她说完先靠近一点，视线短暂落向他的嘴唇，再回到他的眼睛。
26.2—27.0秒，时言低下头，知夏微微抬起下巴，两人各自缩短剩下的距离。
27.0—28.0秒，两人轻轻吻一下。
28.0—30.0秒，嘴唇分开几厘米，知夏忍不住笑出来；时言这才放松肩膀，跟着笑。两人仍牵着手，额头轻轻靠近，停留在仍有呼吸和微笑的动态画面中。

Environment：
身后的雨一直正常落下。结尾仍能看见雨棚边缘的水滴接连坠落。

Camera：
50mm双人侧面中近景（Side-profile medium close-up），两张脸与相牵的手入画。
缓慢推进约十厘米（Slow push-in），保持双方侧脸完整，不切嘴唇大特写。
最后一秒稳定停留，人物仍然自然活动。

Style：
真实、短暂的亲吻。以两人吻后的笑收尾，音乐轻轻落定。

Performance：
“这遍”带笑，“算数”认真。
亲吻由双方共同靠近完成；时言不突然扑过去，知夏不突然僵住。
吻后笑意从眼睛开始，再到嘴角。

Constraints：
嘴唇接触前双方均已停止说话。
不掐腰、不抓后脑、不遮挡脸。
结尾不再暂停时间，不定格画面，不出现片名。

────────────────────

NEGATIVE / 全片负面约束：
角色换脸、发型漂移、眼镜消失、服装变化、三视图分屏、复制人物。
把环境暂停做成整幅画面冻结；暂停期间雨滴漂浮移动；恢复时间后雨滴仍悬停。
冰晶、发光雨滴、魔法阵、能量波、粒子爆炸、环境突然换景。
提前微笑泄露反转、夸张瞪眼、全程傻笑、机械念白、无声说话。
台词串角色、双方同时说话、口型不同步、增加解释超能力的旁白。
牵手换边、手指融合、多余手臂、亲吻时脸部融合、肢体穿模。
慢动作、速度渐变、突然越轴、无依据的焦点跳动、磨皮塑料感。
字幕、屏幕文字、片头片尾标题、水印、品牌标志、黑边。

title: 给你留了个位置：沙发一镜拥抱
author: @johnAGI168
summary: 20 秒固定机位横屏：女主挤进沙发空位，男主轻拍后背再举起手机，指尖点脸颊收尾。
prompt:
SEEDANCE 2.5｜《给你留了个位置》
时长 20 秒｜横幅｜真人情侣居家生活片段｜固定机位，一镜到底

【角色绑定】
@图片1 为男主。面部轮廓、五官比例、发际线与发型以男主角色卡为准。穿奶白色宽松圆领长袖家居上衣，面料柔软、略有绒感，配灰褐色细格纹直筒睡裤。靠镜头一侧的手握一部黑色手机，靠沙发背一侧的手负责揽她。
@图片2 为女主。面部轮廓、五官比例与发型以女主角色卡为准。穿象牙白成套睡衣，长袖小翻领开襟上衣配同色宽松长裤，布面有细小分散的深色碎花，灯下有一点柔软的光泽。保留两张卡各自的脸部特征，侧脸、低头和局部遮挡时也能辨认是同一个人。

【房间与机位】
夜里的小客厅，奶油色布沙发横贯画面。画左的边柜上亮着一盏台灯，大棕色泰迪熊靠在左后方，画右的沙发靠背上有一只黑白格抱枕。台灯是主要光源，靠灯的脸颊、睡衣袖口和扶手泛着蜂蜜色，远离灯的一侧保留柔软暗部。白衣与沙发仍能看出各自的纹理。
镜头架在沙发正前方略高处，轻微向下看。用双人中全景同时容纳画左的头肩、画右蜷起的膝盖，以及沙发前缘拿手机的手。全片锁定这个构图。画面略软，有一点家用相机的颗粒感，像房间里恰好放着一台相机。

【连续动作与表演】
0–3 秒｜男主已经横躺在沙发上，后脑枕着画左的扶手，双腿伸向画右。近镜侧的手松松握着手机，垂在沙发前缘。女主从画右俯身进来，他先转眼看她，靠沙发背的那条手臂自然抬开一点。她看准他腰侧的空位，一只手先撑实坐垫，再把一侧膝盖挪上沙发。掌下的软垫先陷下去，随后才承住她身体的重量。

3–7 秒｜女主沿着沙发往画左挪，把髋部转过来，肩膀侧下去，滑进男主与靠背之间。她转脸时短短地笑了一下，随后低头，把脸颊埋进他的肩窝，双腿收回画右，屈膝侧蜷。两人最终都是头在左、腿在右。等她的肩落稳，男主抬着的手臂才松下来，掌心恰好搭在她上背。拿手机的手仍在外侧。

7–13 秒｜给他们几秒真正躺稳的时间。男主把手机低低斜托在腰腹旁，脸稍稍朝她偏过去。另一只手从她肩背轻抬，向后脑方向顺一下，再落回上背，隔着睡衣轻轻拍两下，两次间隔略有长短。女主一直枕着他，肩膀随着呼气慢慢松下来。保留掌心落下时衣料细微的起伏，以及两次轻拍之间的安静。

13–16 秒｜女主先从他肩窝转出半张脸，下颌仍枕在他肩胸上，眼睛微弯。男主这时才把黑色手机从腰腹抬到胸前，竖着握，屏幕朝向两人，手腕顺势往她那边偏一点。她的视线跟过去，露出一个很小的笑。两个人的头始终挨得很近。

16–20 秒｜女主从他胸前慢慢抬起手，用指尖碰一下他的脸颊，停在靠近嘴角的位置。动作很轻，她的头和膝盖仍在原处。男主手里继续举着手机，另一只手安稳搭在她肩上。最后两秒留给这个姿势，只看得到呼吸、指尖很小的调整和衣料轻微起伏，直接结束。

【声音与约束】
低声的英文演唱配柔和钢琴，像房间里一直放着的一首慢歌。女主上沙发时，音乐下隐约听见布料摩擦和坐垫受压的闷响。两人没有台词，不跟唱。全程不切特写、不推拉、不看镜头。保持手臂分工、手机位置和沙发承重连续；不加接吻、字幕、账号水印或片尾文字。

title: 电梯里的勇敢误会：20 秒近身战
author: @Mavern_0x
summary: 竖屏电梯全封闭动作：紫发女主在密闭轿厢里制服两个挑衅的成年男子，直到楼层到达。
prompt:
FORMAT
20-second vertical 9:16 cinematic action scene. Photorealistic live-action appearance, natural human movement, detailed practical surroundings, real-time pacing. The entire scene takes place inside one elevator. All three characters are adults.

HEROINE
A stylish 25-year-old woman with a violet chin-length bob, dark roots, expressive eyes and natural makeup. An athletic, naturally curvy silhouette, without exaggerated anatomy or emphasis on individual body parts.
She wears a fitted opaque black high-neck top, a cropped charcoal jacket, a structured black utility mini skirt with integrated fitted shorts, opaque black tights and black ankle boots with secure fastenings and low, broad heels. Subtle silver earrings and small violet stitching details complete her fashion-forward look.
Frame her as the capable protagonist of a grounded action film. Her clothes remain intact and provide coverage throughout the fight.
No implants, enhancements or supernatural abilities. Her fighting experience is expressed through alertness, compact movements and recovery of balance. She visibly feels impacts and becomes breathless.

OTHER CHARACTERS
Two intimidating adult men with muscular but realistic builds and ordinary street clothing:
A wears a gray T-shirt and begins closest to her on the rear-left side.
B wears a black sleeveless shirt and begins nearer the center-right, closer to the doors.
No weapons. Give them distinct, consistent faces and clothing.

ELEVATOR AND GEOGRAPHY
A spacious passenger elevator, approximately 2.4 meters wide and 2.2 meters deep, with brushed steel walls, a rear handrail, a small mirror panel and a matte nonslip floor. Neutral overhead lighting, restrained cool reflections, visible wear on metal and realistic fingerprints around the controls.
The destination button 25 is already illuminated. The starting floor is unspecified. The elevator is traveling during the confrontation and arrives at floor 25 at the end.
Doors are at the front. The heroine begins near the rear-center. Keep positions and screen direction consistent.
A eventually sits in the rear-left corner and B ends on the floor along the right wall, away from the door track. Leave a central space for the heroine.
Nobody leaves the elevator during the clip.

TIMELINE

00:00-00:04.00 | CONFRONTATION
View from just inside the front-right corner, looking toward the rear. The doors finish closing. Establish all three adults and the illuminated destination button.
A crowds the heroine, blocking her path toward the controls. He says, "You're not going anywhere."
She looks directly at him and answers, "Back off."
B steps closer and grabs her left jacket sleeve near the wrist. The fabric tightens as he pulls. She takes a small involuntary step, then plants her foot to steady herself.
There is no sexual touching or sexual dialogue. This is an intimidation scene that develops into self-defense.

00:04.00-00:08.00 | BREAKING FREE
She turns with B's pull and breaks his grip. A short defensive shove sends him one step backward against the right wall. He remains upright and begins recovering immediately.
A reaches toward her. She redirects his arm during a brief close struggle and uses his forward momentum to turn him into the rear-left wall, shoulder first.
Show the approach, contact and result clearly. A loses balance and slides into the rear-left corner, holding his bruised forearm close to his body. No fracture, unnatural bending or visible wound.
B is already moving back toward her. The men do not stand still waiting for separate turns.

00:08.00-00:12.00 | THE HEAVIER ATTACKER
B lunges toward her with a broad shove. His hand catches her upper shoulder, pushing her sideways and shifting her jacket. She braces against the wall and visibly struggles to recover her footing.
As he crowds forward, she pivots clear of his path. He must take an awkward corrective step around A's legs.
His shoulder briefly rattles the handrail as he stumbles. The metal sound comes from that actual contact. He stays on his feet and turns back toward her.

00:12.00-00:16.50 | THE FINAL ATTEMPT
B grabs the front of her jacket and tries to pin her. Fabric stretches naturally without tearing. She turns with the pressure and frees herself after a brief struggle.
He advances again. She steadies her supporting foot and delivers one compact defensive front kick to his lower torso, below the chest, pushing him away.
Show the preparation, single contact, withdrawal of her boot and his loss of balance in one uninterrupted medium-wide view. The kick does not strike his head.
He takes a backward step, loses balance, falls against the right wall and lands heavily on his hip, sitting on the floor clear of the door mechanism. His head does not hit the wall or floor.
He remains conscious, winded and unwilling to get up, drawing one leg toward himself. She immediately returns her foot to the floor and takes a small corrective step.
No triumphant extra blows after anyone falls.

00:16.50-00:20.00 | ARRIVAL
The heroine stands in the central gap near the rear, breathing hard. She checks each man before lowering her hands.
A remains in the rear-left corner holding his forearm. B remains seated along the right wall, catching his breath. Both remain visible or spatially accounted for.
She straightens her jacket, brushes violet hair away from her face and allows a small, tense smile of relief.
At approximately 00:18.50, the elevator slows gently and the indicator reads 25. A normal arrival chime sounds. The doors open by the final frame, revealing an empty hallway.

prompt:
Make a 10-minute nature documentary about real dinosaurs, from the first dinosaurs on Pangaea to the asteroid. 4K, 21:9, 24 fps, English narration.

STORY
20 scenes of 30 seconds through the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous: Coelophysis on Pangaea, drought and eruptions, Plateosaurus, Brachiosaurus, Diplodocus, Stegosaurus vs Allosaurus, Archaeopteryx over a lagoon, the first flowers, Spinosaurus hunting a giant fish, Quetzalcoatlus in flight, the fighting dinosaurs of the Gobi, T. rex and Triceratops at Hell Creek, the impact, the ash and one surviving bird.

LOCATIONS
13 location plates in Soul Cinema, 21:9. Vivid, untouched prehistoric wilderness, 28mm anamorphic, deep focus, volumetric light. Prehistoric flora only: no grass, no palm trees, no flowers before the Cretaceous. No people, roads or man-made objects. Nothing should look like a park, a plantation or a road.

DINOSAURS
A 4-angle turnaround sheet in Seedream 5.0 Pro for each of the 15 species before any video: side, front, back, three-quarter. Scientifically accurate: feathered Velociraptor, T. rex with lips over its teeth, Plateosaurus and T. rex on two legs. Use the sheets as references in every scene.

VIDEO
Seedance 2.5 in 4K with the location plate and species sheets as references. Write "no music" into every prompt, then strip the music from every clip anyway and keep only the effects.

CAMERA
Mostly handheld and always moving. Walk up to the animals, run alongside them, let splashes and dust hit the lens. Drone flyovers for scale. No static shots and no drone visible in frame.

NARRATION
A deep, warm, unhurried nature documentary narrator. 40 lines of real paleontology facts, two per scene. Check every line with a transcript so no stage directions get read aloud.

MUSIC
Four orchestral themes that follow the eras, instrumental only. Duck it under the voice, full level in the pauses.

SOUND DESIGN
An ambience bed for every scene: canyon wind, forest, lagoon, swamp, sandstorm, rain, crickets before the impact, the silence of ash. Accents on the action: Brachiosaurus footsteps with sub-bass, the Diplodocus tail whip, splashes, wingbeats, the T. rex rumble, the impact and the shockwave. Soft whooshes on scene changes, low ones on era changes.

EDIT
Crossfade picture and sound on every cut: 0.75 s between scenes, 1 s between eras, 1.5 s into the ash. Mix to -16 LUFS.

TITLES
Come up with a title and design it the way big nature documentaries do. Open with "Documentary made with Higgsfield", centered, in a cinematic font. Burn in English subtitles synced to the voice word by word.

QC
Check every scene frame by frame for morphing, extra limbs, wrong leg counts, bodies passing through each other and story mismatches on the cuts. Regenerate broken shots between clean first and last frames.

[SETTING AND CONTINUITY｜场景与连续性]

美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶附近的一座虚构大型国际机场，午夜。室外天空保持黑色。

[VISUAL LANGUAGE｜电影摄影]

真实皮肤、黑色织物、薄纱、金属、玻璃和混凝土。细微胶片颗粒，克制镜头光晕，明暗层次稳定。

title: 夜路砍刀：十七秒十六硬切
author: @bmx_ai13
summary: 17 秒定时多镜喜剧动作：菜刀飞进车窗、慢镜头穿舱，急刹之后乘客全摔下车。
prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
Night, a narrow wet hillside road lined with red paper lanterns and banyan trees. A dark navy compact MPV is stopped at the roadside. A long-haired woman outside throws a meat cleaver through the open driver window. It tumbles through the cabin past the passengers, exits the far side and sticks in a tree trunk. The panicked driver floors it, then brakes. Every door bursts open and passengers tumble onto the asphalt. A biker girl in a pink helmet watches from beside a banyan tree. Comedic horror-action tone, total duration 17 seconds.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
image1: young woman, slim, long straight jet-black hair over half her face, oversized grey-white varsity jacket with black sleeves, cold blank stare. 100% matches the reference.
image2: young woman driver, early 20s, black hair with bright red streaks, red knit scarf, cream coat, wide-eyed. 100% matches the reference.
image3: young man front passenger, early 20s, black-rimmed glasses, messy brown fringe, bright green jacket, expressive panicked face. 100% matches the reference.
image4: young woman biker, black/white/hot-pink full-face helmet with yellow zigzag graphic and white "6" on the side, pink hair visible through the open visor, black tank top, red motorcycle. 100% matches the reference.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: wet dark asphalt reflecting red lantern glow. Midground: navy MPV, side sliding doors and rear hatch, plate ending "6755". Background: mossy stone retaining wall, banyan aerial roots, string of red paper lanterns, deep green foliage. Light: cool blue-cyan moonlight from above-left, warm red lantern spill from behind the car.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot, 17.0s. Cuts only at the specified points, the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS
FOV set per segment below, no drift mid-segment. Spherical prime lens look, shallow depth of field on close-ups, natural motion blur on fast action.

CAMERA
Mostly handheld with a short reaction lag, eye-level unless stated. Fast whip pans carry real motion blur. Film-like tonal latitude, soft highlight roll-off on lantern light.

ACTION
0.0s to 0.5s — MCU 29°, image1 leans into frame from the right toward camera, hair swinging across her face, right arm whipping forward in a throwing motion; camera whips left with her arm into a full motion-blur smear.
0.5s WHIP CUT
0.5s to 2.2s — MS 47°, static profile of the MPV driver window from outside. image2 at the wheel (left) and image3 beside her (right), both mouths wide open, screaming. A rectangular steel meat cleaver with a wooden handle spins end over end in the foreground just outside the window, flying into the cabin. At 2.0s image3 ducks hard toward image2.
2.2s HARD CUT
2.2s to 6.2s — SLOW MOTION 4x, interior, CU 63°, handheld. The cleaver tumbles slowly through the dim cabin past the headrests, blade glinting. It passes 10 cm in front of the face of a teenage boy in the back seat (dark hair, red shirt collar), who sits frozen, eyes tracking it. Background blurred.
6.2s HARD CUT
6.2s to 6.4s — WS 84°, real-time: the navy MPV on the lantern-lit road, the cleaver bursting out of the far window.
6.4s WHIP CUT
6.4s to 7.5s — whip pan right onto a thick tree trunk; the cleaver thunks deep into the bark at chest height, handle vibrating, flakes of bark spraying.
7.5s HARD CUT
7.5s to 8.2s — CU 29°, two-shot inside the car: image2 and image3 cheek to cheek, eyes bulging, image3 baring his teeth in terror.
8.2s INSERT CUT
8.2s to 8.6s — ECU 12°, footwell: a black-and-white canvas sneaker slams the accelerator pedal flat.
8.6s HARD CUT
8.6s to 9.2s — MCU 47°: violent acceleration throws image2 and image3 sideways against their seats, hair and scarf flying, heavy motion blur.
9.2s HARD CUT
9.2s to 9.4s — low CU 63° on the front bumper and headlight: the car lurches to a hard stop, nose dipping.
9.4s HARD CUT
9.4s to 10.3s — WS 63°, side view against the stone wall: both sliding doors and front doors fling open from the braking inertia, a hunched wild-haired figure in ragged dark clothes tumbles out of the rear door onto the road.
10.3s HARD CUT
10.3s to 11.4s — WS 47°, low angle from behind the car, rear hatch wide open: a young man in a grey jacket crouches among cardboard boxes in the cargo area, arms flailing; two shaggy-haired figures in ragged clothes roll out of the hatch and land on hands and knees on the asphalt in the foreground.
11.4s HARD CUT
11.4s to 12.3s — MS 47°, ground level: a girl in a fluffy pink-white coat with dark hair tumbles out of the open side door and rolls twice across the wet asphalt; camera pans with the roll.
12.3s HARD CUT
12.3s to 13.4s — WS 63°, static: image4 sits on her red motorcycle beside the banyan tree. The navy MPV rolls slowly into frame from the right at 10 km/h and pulls up beside her.
13.4s HARD CUT
13.4s to 14.7s — MCU 29°, from inside the car past image3: his profile in sharp focus at right, mouth open mid-yell, turning toward the window; image4 soft-focus behind the glass at left.
14.7s HARD CUT
14.7s to 15.6s — CU 18°, image4 behind her open visor, eyes sliding sideways toward the car in a cool, unimpressed side-glance, eyebrows lifting slightly.
15.6s HARD CUT
15.6s to 17.0s — WS 47°, low angle from behind the open rear hatch, static: the young man in the grey jacket lies flat on his stomach across the boxes in the cargo area, arms spread, eyes wide and frozen. Two knives and a cleaver stand stuck upright in the boxes on either side of his head. The shaggy figures lie sprawled in the blurred foreground. Hold on his stunned face to the end.

PERFORMANCE
Broad comedic panic in close-ups: jaws dropped wide, eyebrows lifted high, neck tendons tight, visible breath. image1 stays expressionless, eyes dead calm. image4 is pure deadpan, with only the eyes and brows moving. Pore-level skin detail, wet catch-lights in every eye.

PHYSICS
The cleaver has real weight: it spins at a steady rate and embeds with a sharp stop and a handle quiver. The car body pitches forward under braking and rocks back. Bodies tumbling out keep their momentum, roll, and slide on the wet asphalt. Doors swing open and bounce on their hinges.

LIGHTING
Night exterior, 5600K cool blue-cyan moonlight key from above-left, warm 3200K red lantern rim from behind. Cabin lit by a dim warm dome light and spill from the street. Wet road reflections. Haze 15% between the trees in the background.

COLOR GRADE
Teal-cyan foliage and night sky against warm lantern reds. The navy car paint catches cyan highlights. The green jacket, red scarf and pink helmet pop as the saturated accents.

AUDIO
Whoosh of the spinning cleaver, a deep wooden THUNK into the tree, screams, engine roar, tyre screech, doors banging, bodies thudding on asphalt. Comedic beat of silence on the final shot.

STYLE
Photoreal modern streaming-drama look, high detail, fine film grain, punchy comedy-horror pacing.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
Total 17.0s. The 2.2s–6.2s segment is 4x slow motion; every other segment is real time. Speed changes only at hard cuts.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Same navy MPV in every exterior shot. Faces, hair and wardrobe stay identical across cuts. Same cleaver design throughout: rectangular steel blade, wooden handle. Night and wet road in every shot. Cuts land exactly on the stated seconds.

title: 最后地平线：沙暴吞没车队
author: @Goodmanprotocol
summary: 15 秒 IMAX 科幻战争三段：超级沙暴追击装甲车队，越沙丘一跃之后切黑。
prompt:
15-SECOND CINEMATIC SEQUENCE — “THE LAST HORIZON”

Visual Style: IMAX 70mm large-format cinematography, monumental scale, Denis Villeneuve-inspired visual language, uncompromising gritty realism, desaturated desert palette, atmospheric depth, physically realistic environmental effects, immense cinematic contrast. Every frame should feel like a moment captured from an epic science-fiction war film.

[00:00–00:05] — THE WRATH OF NATURE

An extreme-wide aerial shot reveals an endless desert beneath a dying sun. On the distant horizon, an impossibly colossal sandstorm rises like a moving mountain, its blackened wall swallowing the sky. Miles of dust and sand surge across the landscape, consuming everything in their path. Far below, a tiny convoy of heavily armored military rovers races across the dunes, desperately fleeing the approaching darkness. The vehicles appear insignificant against the sheer magnitude of nature. The camera slowly pushes forward as the storm devours the horizon. Deep sub-bass rumbles and a rising orchestral tension build an overwhelming sense of impending destruction.

[00:05–00:10] — NO WAY BACK

Hard cut to a violently shaking cockpit camera inside the lead military rover. The terrified pilot grips the controls as visibility collapses. Sand and debris hammer the reinforced windshield, while the last remaining sunlight disappears behind the advancing wall of dust. Warning lights flicker across the dashboard. The engine screams under maximum strain.

The pilot desperately shouts: “GO! GO! GO!”

A bold subtitle flashes: MAX POWER!

The camera jolts with every impact as the rover accelerates into the blinding sand. Outside, the world disappears into darkness.

[00:10–00:15] — THE FINAL LEAP

Cut to a breathtaking exterior side angle. The lead rover charges up the crest of an enormous desert dune and launches violently into the air. Time suddenly slows. Its massive armored silhouette hangs suspended against the approaching black superstorm, wheels spinning freely, sand cascading beneath its chassis. Inside the storm, colossal lightning bolts illuminate the swirling dust for split seconds, revealing the terrifying scale of the destruction. Chunks of rock, metal fragments and sand blast past the camera lens.

The rover begins its descent.

CUT TO ABSOLUTE BLACK ON IMPACT.

A single earth-shattering cinematic impact reverberates through the silence.

END.

Cinematography & Sound Design: Monumental IMAX compositions, restrained camera movement transitioning into chaotic handheld realism, naturalistic motion blur, volumetric dust, realistic vehicle physics, enormous environmental scale, deep cinematic percussion, sub-bass pressure, metallic engine distortion and thunderous atmospheric sound design. No artificial-looking CGI, no oversaturated colors, no unnecessary visual effects. Every second must feel physically terrifying, immersive and overwhelmingly real.

title: 第一人称：外星巨城巷战
author: @AIReelofficial
summary: 20 秒一镜到底第一人称科幻战争：士兵从巷战打到四足外星战争机器，镜头始终锁在持枪双手。
prompt:
Duration: 20 seconds
Aspect Ratio: 16:9
Visual Style: Photorealistic, cinematic sci-fi war film, large-scale Hollywood blockbuster realism.
Camera Perspective: Strict first-person combat POV.
Shot Design: One continuous real-time tracking shot, no cuts.
[CORE POV & CHARACTER CONSISTENCY]
A human combat soldier fighting through the frontline of a massive extraterrestrial invasion.
The entire sequence is experienced directly through the soldier's eyes. The camera represents the soldier's actual head position and movement, maintaining a realistic human eye-level perspective.
The soldier's armored hands, gloves, sleeves, and futuristic energy rifle remain consistently visible in the foreground whenever physically appropriate.

Weapon identity lock: Maintain exactly the same futuristic energy rifle throughout the entire sequence. It has a dark metallic body, recognizable mechanical structure, and blue-white illuminated energy components. Never change its shape, proportions, color, or design.

Both hands maintain anatomically correct positions on the weapon. The rifle responds naturally to running, aiming, firing, recoil, taking cover, and movement.

Never show the protagonist from a third-person perspective.

[ENVIRONMENT & CINEMATIC WORLD]

A gigantic alien megacity is under siege at night.

The battlefield is an enormous devastated avenue surrounded by towering black biomechanical skyscrapers, shattered metallic structures, damaged military vehicles, and strange luminous alien vegetation.

Glowing cyan energy veins run through cracks in the ground and along the alien architecture. Burning wreckage, drifting ash, sparks, dust, and dense volumetric smoke fill the streets.

Above the city, colossal alien motherships dominate the stormy sky. Human warships and fighter aircraft engage alien spacecraft in an ongoing aerial battle.

Blue, violet, and orange explosions intermittently illuminate the clouds and reflect across the metallic buildings.

Create strong cinematic depth:

Foreground: the soldier's hands, rifle, nearby debris, and close combat.

Midground: human soldiers, alien infantry, wrecked vehicles, and the giant alien war machine.

Background: enormous biomechanical buildings, aircraft, motherships, and distant explosions.

The environment must feel physically enormous, dangerous, and continuously engaged in warfare.

[CONTINUOUS ACTION SEQUENCE]

0–5 SECONDS | SPRINT INTO THE WARZONE

Begin immediately with the soldier sprinting forward through a devastated alien avenue.

The energy rifle is held at chest level with both hands. Each running step creates natural vertical camera movement and corresponding weapon sway.

Broken machinery, damaged vehicles, glowing alien structures, and scattered debris pass rapidly along both sides of the camera, creating convincing first-person depth and foreground parallax.

Several human soldiers rush across the avenue ahead, moving between damaged vehicles and collapsing structures.
Blue and violet plasma artillery streak through the distant sky.

A gigantic alien dropship suddenly flies low between two towering buildings. Its enormous shadow moves across the avenue as a distant explosion illuminates the surrounding architecture.

The soldier maintains forward momentum, running directly toward the frontline.

Camera movement is urgent but controlled, with realistic running inertia and subtle impact vibration.

5–10 SECONDS | ALIEN INFANTRY FIREFIGHT

Three hostile alien infantry suddenly emerge from thick smoke between collapsed structures approximately 15 meters ahead.

They are tall extraterrestrial warriors with elongated silhouettes, dark biomechanical armor, and glowing violet energy weapons.

The soldier immediately raises the rifle and fires several controlled blue-white energy bursts toward them.

The rifle produces visible muzzle energy, brief mechanical recoil, and subtle movement in the soldier's armored hands.

The aliens return fire. Violet projectiles travel visibly toward the soldier.
One incoming projectile strikes the wall immediately beside the camera, causing a sudden localized explosion. The wall fractures, metallic fragments and glowing debris scatter across the foreground, and a short pressure wave shakes the camera.

The soldier reacts instantly, strafing right and dropping behind a wrecked armored vehicle.

The camera lowers naturally as the soldier slides into cover. The rifle remains visible in both hands.

After briefly taking cover, the soldier leans around the vehicle's edge and fires another controlled burst toward the alien infantry.

Keep all three enemies in consistent positions. Their movements, weapon directions, projectile paths, and impacts must remain spatially coherent.

10–15 SECONDS | THE GIANT ALIEN WAR MACHINE

The soldier pushes away from cover and moves forward into the avenue.

A controlled burst of blue-white energy fire hits the nearest alien directly in the chest.

The impact creates a bright flash, sparks, and several fragments of damaged armor. The alien is physically knocked backward and collapses onto the street.

The remaining two aliens retreat into the surrounding smoke.

Behind them, an enormous four-legged alien war machine slowly emerges between the towering buildings.

Its mechanical legs step heavily onto the avenue, crushing debris and producing visible dust clouds with every impact. Its massive armored body rises above the surrounding architecture.
The machine turns toward the soldier.

A gigantic energy cannon mounted on its body begins charging. Violet energy builds inside the cannon, growing progressively brighter and illuminating the surrounding armor.

At the same time, human fighter aircraft roar overhead and launch missiles toward its upper armor.

The missiles approach and strike in rapid succession, creating large localized explosions. Sparks, burning fragments, and smoke burst outward from the machine's armor.

The soldier continues advancing while raising the rifle and firing toward its exposed glowing components.

The scale difference between the soldier and the enormous machine must feel overwhelming.

15–20 SECONDS | DEVASTATING ENERGY ATTACK & BATTLEFIELD REVEAL

The alien war machine completes its charging sequence and unleashes a massive violet energy beam across the avenue.

The soldier immediately ducks and moves behind a shattered section of nearby architecture.

The beam tears through the street and nearby structures. The impact produces an intense violet flash, followed by collapsing walls, molten metallic fragments, dust, and a powerful wave of debris.

The camera reacts with a brief, physically motivated shockwave shake.

As the beam passes, the soldier immediately emerges from cover and sprints forward through the destruction.

Above the avenue, a damaged alien fighter loses control and crashes into the street ahead. It strikes the ground and slides across the roadway, producing a violent shower of sparks, burning fragments, and thick smoke.

The soldier adjusts direction naturally and runs past the burning wreckage.
As the smoke clears, the soldier reaches a more open section of the avenue.

The view gradually reveals an enormous battlefield stretching toward the horizon.

Hundreds of human soldiers and alien infantry are fighting across the ruined city. Giant alien war machines advance between buildings. Human fighters and alien aircraft exchange fire overhead. Colossal motherships dominate the storm-filled sky, surrounded by distant explosions and energy fire.

The soldier keeps the same energy rifle raised in the foreground and continues running directly toward the larger battle.

End with the battlefield filling the entire forward view, creating an overwhelming sense of scale and an ongoing planetary invasion.

[CAMERA MOVEMENT & CINEMATOGRAPHY]

Maintain a strict first-person human eye-level camera throughout.

The camera must behave like a real soldier physically moving through the battlefield:

Natural running bounce and body inertia.

Subtle head movement synchronized with footsteps.

Controlled camera shake during nearby explosions and impacts.

Fast but readable lateral movement during strafing.

Natural lowering of the camera when crouching behind cover.

Small forward and sideways movements when leaning around obstacles.

Strong foreground parallax as nearby structures pass.

Brief physically motivated motion blur during fast movement.

Clear visibility of important enemies and combat actions.

Maintain continuous forward movement whenever the soldier is not actively taking cover or dodging.

No floating camera movement, artificial camera rotation, impossible acceleration, or sudden changes in perspective.

[COMBAT EFFECTS & PHYSICAL INTERACTIONS]

All combat effects must have clear physical origins and consequences.

Energy projectiles travel along visible trajectories and strike specific surfaces or targets.

Weapon recoil is brief and consistent with every firing burst.

Alien armor reacts to direct impacts through localized sparks, energy flashes, and physically plausible fragmentation.

Explosions produce directional debris, expanding dust clouds, nearby surface illumination, and short shockwave reactions.

The alien war machine moves with convincing mechanical weight. Its legs articulate naturally, and each footstep affects the ground and nearby debris.

Falling spacecraft and burning wreckage must follow believable gravity, momentum, collision, and sliding behavior.

Volumetric smoke and atmospheric particles respond naturally to explosions and environmental movement.

Keep effects visually spectacular but avoid covering the entire image with smoke, flashes, or motion blur.

[AUDIO & SOUND DESIGN]

A dense, immersive cinematic battlefield soundscape with strong spatial depth.

Close-range audio: Heavy armored footsteps, controlled breathing, rifle charging, energy weapon firing, mechanical recoil, armor movement, debris hitting nearby surfaces.

Mid-range audio: Alien weapon discharge, human soldiers shouting, metallic impacts, explosions, collapsing architecture, falling debris, burning wreckage.

Long-range audio: Fighter engines passing overhead, missile launches, massive artillery booms, spacecraft engines, alien mothership rumbles, and deep low-frequency shockwaves.

Sound effects must synchronize precisely with the visible actions. Nearby impacts should sound immediate and sharp, while distant explosions have deep reverberation.

No background music is necessary; prioritize immersive environmental and combat audio.

[STRICT NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS]

Strict first-person POV only. No third-person shots. No external view of the protagonist. No camera cuts. No scene transitions. No teleportation. No sudden location changes.

No additional hands, duplicated fingers, deformed gloves, or changing armor sleeves.

No weapon morphing, weapon disappearance, weapon redesign, or inconsistent hand positions.

No sudden enemy duplication or unexplained enemy appearance.

No random explosions without visible causes. No impossible projectile trajectories. No floating debris without physical causes.

No excessive camera shake that makes the action unreadable.

No HUD, no crosshair, no subtitles, no text, no logos, no watermarks, and no video-game interface elements.

FINAL PRIORITY: A continuous, physically believable first-person combat experience. Preserve the identity of the soldier's hands and rifle, maintain consistent battlefield geography, and deliver escalating cinematic action from close-range infantry combat to a colossal alien invasion.

title: kilat：公寓大火里的闪电救人
author: @bozzxyz
summary: 30 秒竖屏三渲二短片：印尼飞人把时间冻结，在着火公寓里救出十人，顺手吃完漂浮宵夜。
prompt:
A 30-second cinematic 3D-animated short film, stylized Pixar-meets-Spider-Verse look: soft subsurface skin shading, slightly exaggerated proportions, tactile fabric and painterly textures, warm natural lighting. Vertical 9:16.

Hero: a lanky 20-year-old Indonesian guy, the fastest man alive, dressed in a relaxed indie "skena" street outfit — messy black wolf-cut hair, small silver hoop earring, thin round glasses, oversized washed-black graphic tee under an open olive corduroy overshirt, wide-leg light-wash jeans, chunky white retro sneakers with red laces, a silver chain, wired earphones and a canvas tote bag. No costume, no mask, no logo. When he runs, crackling electric-cyan lightning trails off his body and sneakers.

Story: a 12-storey apartment block is burning at night. He runs so fast that time almost stops — flames hang like orange glass, embers and smoke float still, sprinkler water hangs in beads — while he moves at normal speed, casually rescuing exactly 10 people and snacking on floating food along the way. When time restarts, all ten are sitting safely on the curb across the street and he is gone. Tone: playful superhero action-comedy.

Camera language: hyper slow-motion world (1000 fps feel) with the hero moving at normal speed; bullet-time orbits around frozen moments; camera tracking beside him at his speed; speed ramps from real time into near-freeze and back; crash zooms, whip pans, macro inserts, low-angle hero shots.
Lighting: the fire is the motivated warm-orange key and practical light; thick smoke haze with volumetric light shafts; his cyan lightning acts as a moving cool rim light; frozen embers become glowing bokeh. When time freezes the flames stop flickering and the light becomes perfectly still.
Colour: hot orange real-time world shifts to a cooler, slightly desaturated teal when time freezes, then snaps back to warm when time restarts.

Shot 1 (0–3s): Real time. Wide low-angle street at night: the apartment block is burning, a fireball bursts from a 9th-floor window, people scream at windows, sirens in the distance. The hero stands on the sidewalk eating a satay skewer, earphones in, warm firelight flickering on his face.
CUT TO Shot 2 (3–5s): Macro of his eye reflecting the flames, tiny cyan sparks crackling across the iris. He pulls one earphone out and smirks; his sneaker grinds into the asphalt as lightning crawls up the red laces. The title "K I L A T" slams on screen in bold electric-cyan block letters.
CUT TO Shot 3 (5–7s): Speed ramp — he launches, crash zoom, the sound collapses into a low hum, colour drains to cool teal and everything freezes mid-motion: a fireball, falling glass, a pigeon in mid-flight.
CUT TO Shot 4 (7–11s): Frozen smoky hallway, the camera tracks beside him at his speed. He rolls out a grandma in a wheelchair (1), lifts a young mother (2) holding her baby (3), slips sunglasses onto grandma, and zips them down the stairs in cyan streaks.
CUT TO Shot 5 (11–14s): Bullet-time orbit through a corridor of suspended glass shards and frozen sparks. He carries a little girl with a red balloon (4) and an office worker frozen mid-scream (5) whose coffee splash hangs in the air — he scoops the floating coffee back into the cup and snaps the lid on — then tucks a teen gamer in a headset (6), still frozen at his PC, under his arm.
CUT TO Shot 6 (14–19s): Funny beat in an exploded kitchen: food floats frozen in mid-air — noodles, fried chicken, gorengan, a fried egg, glistening spheres of iced tea. He strolls through, slurps a ribbon of floating noodles with chopsticks, bites a hovering drumstick, sips a floating sphere of tea, puts the egg back into the frozen chef's frying pan, then carries the chef (7) away. Macro inserts of the floating food glowing in firelight.
CUT TO Shot 7 (19–22s): A bathroom with steam frozen like cotton: a man in a towel covered in shampoo foam (8), frozen mid-panic. The hero covers his own eyes, wraps him in a bathrobe and plops a shower cap on his head. In the stairwell he grabs a security guard (9) and a delivery rider (10) holding a pizza box, steals one slice, and carries them out through a frozen wall of flame, leaving a cyan lightning tunnel.
CUT TO Shot 8 (22–25s): Wide shot of the frozen street: he seats all ten people in a neat row on the curb across the road, wrapped in blankets, tapping each head as he counts them. Low-angle hero shot as he steps back.
CUT TO Shot 9 (25–28s): Speed ramp back to real time — colour snaps warm, flames roar, glass rains down behind, fire trucks arrive. The ten blink and look at each other, confused: towel guy in a bathrobe and shower cap, grandma in sunglasses, the chef holding his egg pan.
CUT TO Shot 10 (28–30s): The hero leans on a lamp post at the edge of frame, finishes the pizza slice, gives a two-finger salute, pops his earphone back in and vanishes in a cyan streak; one last floating noodle drops into the chef's pan. Subtitle: "Sorry, mampir makan dulu."

Avoid: superhero suit, lightning-bolt emblem, red costume, logos, extra on-screen text besides the title and subtitle, more or fewer than 10 rescued people.

title: 商场一跃：圣诞星点亮中庭
author: @Mavern_0x

prompt:
FORMAT AND LOOK
18 seconds, vertical 9:16. One continuous handheld shot with no cuts, real-time action throughout. Photorealistic accidental eyewitness footage of an impossible-looking holiday stunt during a tree-lighting evening in a huge shopping mall atrium.

The scene itself is a real, richly detailed location with high-end live-action realism: individual pine needles, glass reflections, polished stone floors, fabric weave, skin pores, flyaway hairs, believable crowd faces, real bulbs with filaments, accurate scale and depth. This real scene is recorded through a DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel: subtle fine 16mm-like grain, mild tape texture, authentic consumer-camcorder exposure response, restrained highlight blooming on bulbs, slight auto-white-balance drift when the lights switch on, natural motion blur. The texture is a light layer over a sharp, detailed image, never heavy degradation, smearing, or a fake vintage filter.

Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. The operator is an ordinary shopper who reacts a fraction late to events and never anticipates them. Errors are brief and physically plausible. No stabilized gimbal look, polished commercial moves, drone tracking, or perfect composition.

The camcorder and camera operator NEVER appear on screen, including in glass reflections, mirrors, shop windows, shadows, phone screens, or the foreground. No camera housing, hands holding a camera, recording overlay, timestamp, REC symbol, battery icon, subtitles, captions, text graphics, or borders.

REFERENCES
If a character photo is attached, it defines the woman's face, hair, body type, and identity. Her outfit, props, and actions follow this prompt. Current instructions override conflicting reference details.

WOMAN
A beautiful 21-year-old adult woman, a professional stunt athlete: athletic curvy figure, high ponytail, natural makeup, confident playful expression, consistent facial identity in every frame. Red fitted supportive athletic crop top with thin white trim, opaque high-waisted red cycling shorts ending at mid-thigh, white sneakers, and a small red Santa hat with a white pompom pinned firmly at her ponytail base. Stretch athletic fabric with realistic seams and tension. Clothing and hat stay secure through every flip and impact.
In her right hand: a gold Christmas tree star topper about 45 cm wide, thin brushed-metal frame with frosted glass-like panels and tiny unlit bulbs inside, and a short hollow metal sleeve at its base. This exact star stays in her right hand until it is mounted.

FIXED GEOGRAPHY
A vast six-level mall atrium: white structural bands, escalators, storefronts with holiday windows, continuous glass balustrades with a top rail at waist height, a high glass roof showing dark evening sky. Dim pre-ceremony lighting: store windows glow softly, the atrium itself is in cool blue dusk.
Every gallery rail is wrapped in pine garlands with warm-white bulbs, all OFF. Hundreds of spectators line every gallery and the ground floor behind a velvet-rope circle, filming on phones. They gathered for the tree lighting.

A real 20-meter spruce stands at the ground-floor center, mounted on a hidden steel mast whose top ends in a rigid vertical steel spike with a polished metal contact collar, waiting for the star. Ornaments and wrapped light strings are all OFF. The tree is wide at the base and narrow at the top. Its tip reaches roughly between the fourth and fifth galleries, clearly below the camera's top gallery.

Exactly ONE very large round stunt trampoline with a padded blue rim stands on the ground floor beside the tree, fully clear of the lowest branches, inside the roped circle. Its bed, springs, frame, size, and position never change.

On the top gallery, the woman stands OUTSIDE the glass on a broad exterior stone ledge, roughly above the trampoline. Spatial order from gallery to void: CROWD / CONTINUOUS INTACT GLASS / WOMAN ON LEDGE / OPEN DROP. No gap, gate, or missing panel. Nobody passes through glass.

PHYSICS LOGIC
Drop from the ledge to the trampoline: about 28 meters, five complete gallery levels. Show every level passing. No lens-distortion height faking, no raised trampoline.
The rebound is an intentional cinematic stunt allowance, but it loses energy realistically: she rises to about 20 meters, clearly lower than her starting ledge. All launch energy comes from trampoline contact, and the return path comes from a visible hand push off the steel mast. No aerial boost, hovering, slow motion, speed ramp, or stretched airtime.
Her rising arc starts beside the trampoline and travels inward, staying outside the tree's cone so she never touches branches. Her return arc mirrors it outward, back over the trampoline.

CAMERA BEHAVIOR
The operator stands on the top gallery a few meters along the rail, filming diagonally over the intact rail. Open slightly tilted on the woman outside the glass, crowd behind her, the dark tree far below. The trampoline is hidden beneath the ledge and invisible at first, so it looks as if she intends to jump onto the tree.
On her takeoff the camera reacts late, tilts abruptly down, briefly loses her off-frame edge, recovers her whole body, and only then reveals the trampoline.
During the rebound, follow upward with an uneven tilt and a clumsy partial zoom that overshoots, cuts off her face for an instant, then eases back so her full body, both hands, the spike, and the star are visible at the mounting. Never hide the star contact or the hand push.
Follow her return fall, then pull out shakily as the light spreads. The rising light reaches the operator's own rail and causes a brief exposure flare and focus hunt. End with an imperfect zoom toward her on the trampoline, briefly cropping her forehead before correcting.

TIMELINE
0.00-2.40 seconds: THE WARNING AND THE JUMP.
Slightly tilted framing, her face briefly cut off at the top as the operator lifts the camera. She stands on the ledge, star in her right hand, adjusts one foot, and glances down at the dark tree. Behind the glass, a mall security guard in a navy uniform with a handheld radio shoves through the crowd about four meters to the camera's left and shouts:
"Ma'am! Get back over the rail!"
She glances over her shoulder at him with a tiny confident smile, faces the void, swings her free arm, bends her knees, and jumps deliberately outward. The guard reaches over the top rail a moment too late, his hand closing on empty air. The crowd gasps and screams.

2.40-5.00 seconds: FAST REAL-TIME FALL.
The camera tilts down after her. Five gallery levels and their dark garlands pass behind her as she accelerates under gravity, feet first, star tight against her side, free arm making small corrections. Her ponytail streams upward; the pinned hat stays in place.
The trampoline is revealed only during this follow. Both feet hit its center. Knees flex, the bed sinks deeply, springs stretch, the fabric bottoms out and recoils. Contact, compression, release at normal speed. One contact, one rebound. The ground-floor crowd flinches backward.

5.00-7.20 seconds: RISING ALONG THE TREE.
She launches upward on an inward arc tracking the tree's cone without touching it. Early in the ascent she performs ONE tight backward somersault, star still in her right hand, coherent shoulders, hips, knees, and feet. She opens out facing the tree; ornaments tremble in her air wake.
Her upward speed decreases naturally. At the apex, just above the tip, she catches the rigid steel spike with her LEFT hand and with her RIGHT hand slides the star's hollow sleeve down onto it in one clean motion. The sleeve seats on the contact collar with a firm metallic click and a tiny blue spark.

7.20-7.80 seconds: THE PUSH AND THE BEAT OF SILENCE.
She shoves off the steel mast with her left hand, body tilting backward, sending herself outward onto a return arc toward the trampoline. The mast top sways slightly and settles. The star stays seated and upright.
For a split second nothing lights. The crowd's noise drops into a stunned hush.

7.80-10.00 seconds: THE STAR IGNITES, SHE FALLS.
The star's inner bulbs flicker twice, then blaze warm gold. Instantly the tree's lights begin switching on in fast successive rings from the star downward to the base, ornaments catching the glow, bulbs blooming on the camcorder sensor.
Meanwhile she falls on the outward arc, body upright, arms out for balance, the lighting rings chasing her down beside the tree.

10.00-11.60 seconds: LANDING.
She lands feet first in the trampoline's center, a deep compression, then a smaller second bounce and a short third, energy fading realistically, until she stands on the bed with bent knees and arms out. The tree's base ring lights as she settles.

11.60-14.60 seconds: THE WHOLE MALL LIGHTS UP.
The gallery garlands switch on level by level, rising from the ground floor toward the camera, a wave of warm light climbing the atrium. When the wave reaches the operator's rail, a bright flare washes the frame for a moment and autofocus hunts before snapping back. The atrium is now warm gold instead of cool blue.
Snow machines in the roof start releasing soft white artificial snowflakes that drift down naturally through the lit air, catching the light. Massive cheers, applause, disbelieving laughter. Phones are raised high on every level. The guard stands frozen at the rail, radio lowered, people around him turning to stare at him.

14.60-18.00 seconds: THE PUNCHLINE.
On the trampoline, breathless and grinning, flakes landing on her hair, she straightens her Santa hat, tilts her head up toward the guard, who is to the side of the camera, and points at him. She never looks into the lens. She shouts up, loud and cheeky:
"You're welcome!"
The crowd around the guard roars with laughter. He slowly lifts his radio, speechless.
Right next to the camera, off-screen, a small child's voice asks: "Mom, can I do that?"
The operator's own off-screen voice answers instantly, flat: "Absolutely not."
End on the fully lit tree, the glowing star, falling snow, her pointing up, and the stunned guard.

AUDIO
Authentic camcorder microphone: close crowd voices, huge mall reverberation, slight automatic gain pumping, brief peak distortion only on the loudest screams and cheers. All dialogue stays intelligible.
No added music, voice-over, or cinematic whooshes. Faint generic diegetic mall ambience only.
Sound sequence: anticipation chatter, the guard's shout, gasps and a scream at the jump, air rush, a distant deep elastic trampoline impact with spring creak, rustling needles in her wake, the metallic click and tiny electrical snap of the star, the sudden hush, a rising electrical hum and rapid relay clicks as rings light, an enormous cheer, soft hiss of snow machines, laughter, her shout, the child, the operator's deadpan reply.
Audio perspective stays with the operator on the top gallery. All dialogue is English.

CONTINUITY AND NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
One woman, one guard, one tree, one steel spike, one star, one trampoline, one jump, one big rebound, one backward somersault, one mounting, one hand push, one return fall, fading bounces, one top-down tree cascade, one bottom-up gallery wave.
Preserve identity, red outfit, Santa hat, star design, ledge, intact glass, tree and trampoline positions, crowd positions, and lighting logic: everything festive stays OFF until the star seats, then stays ON.
No branch contact, tree damage, falling ornaments, star dropped, swapped, or switching hands, lights on before the star seats, rebound higher than the starting ledge, return path without the mast push, glass gap, body passing through glass, low drop, extra trampoline, early trampoline reveal, hidden contact, repeated action, slow motion, speed ramp, hovering, morphing anatomy, extra limbs, distorted faces in the crowd, camera-facing dialogue, visible text, or visible camera/operator.

title: 机器人救人：咖啡却没了

prompt:
STYLE: authentic vertical smartphone video filmed handheld by an ordinary passerby on a city sidewalk in the evening. Real phone footage, not cinematic: auto exposure adjusting between bright shop windows and the dark sky, slight digital noise in shadows, mild motion blur on fast movement, autofocus occasionally hunting, slightly crushed blacks, warm sodium streetlight mixed with cool shop-window LED light. Underneath this texture everything is fully real: real people, real skin, real asphalt, real bricks, real dust, real physics.

FORMAT
15 seconds, vertical 9:16, real-time speed, one continuous uncut take, no slow motion, no speed ramps. Photorealistic live-action rescue drama with a dry comic ending. No text, captions, UI overlays, timestamp or music.

REFERENCE
Image #1 defines only the adult female humanoid robot. Preserve exactly: soft youthful adult face, brown eyes, natural brows, subtle makeup; long straight light brown hair with a center part falling past the shoulders; small stud earrings; slim adult build with long legs; fitted beige short-sleeved T-shirt with a small dark chest logo, hem ending just above the waist; high-waisted dark purple cycling shorts with a small front drawstring; white chunky running sneakers. Exposed mechanical waist between shirt hem and waistband: brushed silver mechanical blocks and actuators, small bright white LED lights, bundles of blue, yellow and black wires, metal brackets and fasteners, one blue cable running down her left hip. Her torso is always connected to her pelvis through this mechanism, same scale and construction from every angle. Do not copy the photo's background, crowd, lanyards, stanchions or floor.

PHYSICS RULE
The robot is far stronger and heavier than she looks. This is the only supernatural element and it is consistent: she absorbs the falling load by bending her knees deeply, her sneakers press into the asphalt and crack it, her waist mechanism visibly compresses and trembles under the weight. Everything else obeys real physics: the load swings and falls with real gravity, bricks are heavy and shatter on impact, dust spreads and settles, the man falls with real weight, liquid spills naturally.

CAMERA OPERATOR
The operator is never visible, not even in reflections in shop windows. He stands at the entrance of a small coffee shop about four meters from the action, filming at chest height. The camera looks along the sidewalk: the construction scaffolding runs along the right side of the frame, the street with passing cars is on the left, the robot is in the center.
Real handheld phone behavior: micro-shake, breathing sway, a slight tilt, subjects drifting off-center, late autofocus. He reacts physically: tilts up fast toward the crack above, tilts back down, flinches and steps back at the impact, then slowly steps forward.
These imperfections never hide the key moments: the strap snapping, the pallet tilting, the robot's dash, the push, the pallet falling, the catch, the lowering, the cup being crushed, the lift to his feet and all lines.

CHARACTERS
The Man: around thirty, slim build, short dark brown hair, clean-shaven, navy bomber jacket over a white T-shirt, black trousers, white sneakers, white over-ear headphones on his head, phone in his left hand, paper takeaway coffee cup with a plastic lid in his right hand. Absorbed in his phone, oblivious.
The Worker: construction worker on the scaffolding at third-floor level, about nine meters up, orange hi-vis vest, white hard hat, work gloves.
Passersby: four or five adults: a woman with a shopping bag, an older man, a young couple. Ordinary clothing, real faces, all several meters away from the load.
Robot: calm, focused, silent. Her face stays composed during the whole rescue; effort shows only in her body and mechanism. No bulging muscles, no grimace.
The Man's arc: oblivious, shock, breathless gratitude, deadpan loss.
Passersby's arc: idle, frozen fear, stunned silence.

LOCATION AND BLOCKING
Evening city street just after rain. Wet dark asphalt sidewalk reflecting streetlights and shop windows, shallow puddles. Along the right side: a building under construction with steel scaffolding, green safety netting and plywood hoarding at street level. A tower crane boom crosses the dark sky above with small red warning lights. A pallet of red bricks hangs from the crane hook about twelve meters above the sidewalk on two lifting straps. The bricks are shrink-wrapped in clear plastic and held with steel bands on a wooden pallet, roughly one ton. One top corner of the wrap is already torn, with a few loose bricks on top.
Fixed positions: the robot stands by a lit shop window in the center of the frame, about two meters from the Man's path. The Man walks along the sidewalk from the background toward the camera and stops directly under the hanging load to read something on his phone. Passersby are scattered behind and around them.

TIMELINE

00:00-00:02.2 | CALM
Quiet evening sidewalk. The robot stands by the shop window, waist LEDs glowing softly, reflected in the wet asphalt. The operator films her curiously, focus pulling onto her mechanism. The Man walks into frame, headphones on, scrolling his phone, sipping coffee, and stops under the load. Faint crane motor hum above, traffic noise.

00:02.2-00:04.2 | THE SNAP
At 00:02.2 a sharp metallic crack sounds above: one lifting strap snaps. The pallet jerks and tilts steeply, hanging from the remaining strap, swinging. Three loose bricks slide off the torn corner and fall, smashing on the sidewalk two meters to the side of the Man; he does not notice, his headphones block the sound. The operator tilts up fast, catching the tilted swinging pallet against the dark sky, then tilts back down to the street.
At 00:02.8 the Worker leans over the scaffold rail and shouts: "Look out! Move!"
At 00:03 the robot's head turns up toward the load. She moves: two fast powerful steps toward the Man, sneakers slapping wet asphalt.

00:04.2-00:05.8 | THE PUSH AND THE FALL
At 00:04.2 the second strap slips off the hook with a metallic screech. The pallet drops in free fall.
At 00:04.5 the robot reaches the Man and takes his place. With her left arm she shoves him firmly sideways by the shoulder toward the street side, away from the scaffolding. He stumbles two meters and lands on his back on the wet asphalt, splashing a puddle, fully visible to the camera. His phone stays clutched in his left hand. The coffee cup flies out of his right hand, bounces once and stops upright on the asphalt about half a meter in front of the robot's feet, lid on.

00:05.8-00:08 | THE CATCH
At 00:05.8 the pallet slams into her palms. Massive impact: a deep thud, crack of wood, the steel bands groan. She absorbs the energy by bending her knees deeply into a half squat over about half a second, arms staying straight. Her waist actuators compress hard with a loud mechanical whine, the white LEDs flicker once and stabilize. Her sneakers press two to three centimeters into the asphalt and cracks spread outward around her feet. Four more bricks spill off the torn corner and shatter on the asphalt on the scaffolding side, away from the Man. A cloud of red brick dust bursts out and drifts in the streetlight. Her hair whips down from the air push.
The operator flinches back one step, frame shaking hard, then steadies.
At 00:06.5 she pushes back up to standing, the pallet stable above her head.

00:08-00:11 | THE HOLD AND LOWERING
Near silence: the hum of her mechanism, dust settling, distant traffic. The robot holds about one ton of bricks overhead, completely still, face calm, waist mechanism trembling slightly under the load. Passersby stand frozen, the woman with the shopping bag covering her mouth.
At 00:09 she slowly bends her knees and lowers the pallet slightly forward in a controlled motion. At 00:10.5 the pallet touches down on the asphalt directly onto the coffee cup: a small plastic crunch. Brown coffee squirts out and spreads from under the wooden pallet across the wet asphalt.

00:11-00:13 | GRATITUDE
The robot straightens up and brushes brick dust off her palms with two short claps. The Man sits up on the asphalt, soaked, one ear cup of his headphones pushed off his ear, breathing hard. She steps to him and holds out her hand. He grabs it and she pulls him to his feet in one smooth effortless motion.
The Man, breathless, in natural English:
"...Thank you."
Spoken 00:12.0-00:12.6.
The robot gives a small calm nod.

00:13-00:15 | THE ENDING
At 00:13 the robot turns and walks away along the sidewalk out of frame past the camera, unhurried, waist LEDs glowing, dust on her shorts and sneakers. The Man looks down at the brown coffee puddle spreading from under the pallet and says flatly, in natural English:
"...I just bought that."

From above the Worker shouts: "Sorry!" at 00:14.6. At 00:15 the recording stops abruptly, no fade.

IMAGE DETAIL
Real skin pores, light sweat, flushed skin on the Man. Individual hair strands with natural inertia. Wet bomber jacket with dark water patches after the fall. Wet asphalt with real reflections of shop windows and streetlights, puddle splashes. Bricks with rough porous texture, chipped edges, red dust; sharp fragments scattered after shattering. Wooden pallet with splintered edges, torn shrink wrap, stressed steel bands. Asphalt cracks around her sneakers with crumbled edges. Scaffolding with rusty clamps, safety netting, plywood hoarding. Waist mechanism: brushed silver, white LEDs, colored wires, real reflections of street light, real occlusion shadows, brick dust on the metal. AUDIO
Smartphone microphone: compressed, loud sounds slightly clipped, handling noise. City ambience: traffic, tires on wet road, distant voices, crane motor hum.
Synced sounds: metallic crack of the strap at 00:02.2; strap creak and swinging pallet; three bricks smashing at 00:02.6; robot's sneakers slapping wet asphalt from 00:03; metallic screech of the second strap at 00:04.2; the Man hitting wet asphalt with a splash at 00:04.9; cup bounce; heavy impact thud, wood crack and steel band groan at 00:05.8; loud mechanical whine of her actuators; asphalt crackle under her feet; bricks shattering; continuous hum of her mechanism during the hold; heavy wooden knock and plastic cup crunch at 00:10.5; two dusty palm claps; her footsteps walking away.
Voices: Worker's "Look out! Move!" at 00:02.8; passersby gasps at the impact; operator's sharp breath "Whoa" at 00:05.9; silence during the hold. Then only: the Man's "...Thank you.", "...I just bought that." and the Worker's "Sorry!". The robot is silent. No music.

CONTINUITY
Fixed order: calm, first strap snaps, pallet tilts, three bricks fall, Worker shouts, robot moves, second strap slips, pallet falls, robot pushes the Man aside, he falls, cup stops upright, robot raises arms, catch with deep knee bend, bricks spill, hold, lowering onto the cup, coffee spreads, she lifts him up, "Thank you", she walks away, "I just bought that", "Sorry!", recording stops.
The Man is never under the pallet after the push and no brick lands near him. The coffee cup stays upright on the asphalt until the pallet crushes it. The phone stays in his left hand. Brick fragments, asphalt cracks and dust stay where they fell. The pallet stays on the ground after being lowered. Only one pallet. Consistent faces, wardrobe, light and street layout.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
No cinematic camera look, no 4K sharpness, no gimbal smoothness, no color grading. No cuts, replays or slow motion.
